from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TransactionalFinancialLiability(BaseModel):
    """The '交易性金融负债' (transactional financial liability) item from one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in this document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's security/trading code")
    liability_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of 交易性金融负债 for the period; None if not reported or empty")
    value_has_amount: bool = Field(description="True if a numerical amount exists, False if shown as '-' or empty")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit, e.g. '元'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing this line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_data: list[TransactionalFinancialLiability]
